<h1 id="google-docs-api">Google Docs API v1</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Reads and writes Google Docs documents.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://docs.googleapis.com/">https://docs.googleapis.com/</a>

<a href="https://developers.google.com/terms/">Terms of service</a>
Web: <a href="https://google.com">Google</a> 
License: <a href="http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/">Creative Commons Attribution 3.0</a>

<a href="https://developers.google.com/docs/">External documentation</a>

# Authentication

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 implicit authentication

    - Flow: implicit
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents|See, edit, create, and delete all your Google Docs documents|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents.readonly|See all your Google Docs documents|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive|See, edit, create, and delete all of your Google Drive files|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file|See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly|See and download all your Google Drive files|

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 authorizationCode authentication

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)
    - Token URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents|See, edit, create, and delete all your Google Docs documents|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents.readonly|See all your Google Docs documents|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive|See, edit, create, and delete all of your Google Drive files|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file|See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly|See and download all your Google Drive files|

<h1 id="google-docs-api-documents">documents</h1>

## docs.documents.create

<a id="opIddocs.documents.create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
```

<h3 id="docsdocumentscreate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[Document](#schemadocument)|false|none|
|» body|body|[Body](#schemabody)|false|Output only. The main body of the document.|
|» documentId|body|string|false|Output only. The ID of the document.|
|» documentStyle|body|[DocumentStyle](#schemadocumentstyle)|false|Output only. The style of the document.|
|» footers|body|object|false|Output only. The footers in the document, keyed by footer ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[Footer](#schemafooter)|false|A document footer.|
|» footnotes|body|object|false|Output only. The footnotes in the document, keyed by footnote ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[Footnote](#schemafootnote)|false|A document footnote.|
|» headers|body|object|false|Output only. The headers in the document, keyed by header ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[Header](#schemaheader)|false|A document header.|
|» inlineObjects|body|object|false|Output only. The inline objects in the document, keyed by object ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[InlineObject](#schemainlineobject)|false|An object that appears inline with text. An InlineObject contains an EmbeddedObject such as an image.|
|» lists|body|object|false|Output only. The lists in the document, keyed by list ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[List](#schemalist)|false|A List represents the list attributes for a group of paragraphs that all belong to the same list. A paragraph that's part of a list has a reference to the list's ID in its bullet.|
|» namedRanges|body|object|false|Output only. The named ranges in the document, keyed by name.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[NamedRanges](#schemanamedranges)|false|A collection of all the NamedRanges in the document that share a given name.|
|» namedStyles|body|[NamedStyles](#schemanamedstyles)|false|Output only. The named styles of the document.|
|» positionedObjects|body|object|false|Output only. The positioned objects in the document, keyed by object ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[PositionedObject](#schemapositionedobject)|false|An object that's tethered to a Paragraph and positioned relative to the beginning of the paragraph. A PositionedObject contains an EmbeddedObject such as an image.|
|» revisionId|body|string|false|Output only. The revision ID of the document. Can be used in update requests to specify which revision of a document to apply updates to and how the request should behave if the document has been edited since that revision. Only populated if the user has edit access to the document. The revision ID is not a sequential number but an opaque string. The format of the revision ID might change over time. A returned revision ID is only guaranteed to be valid for 24 hours after it has been returned and cannot be shared across users. If the revision ID is unchanged between calls, then the document has not changed. Conversely, a changed ID (for the same document and user) usually means the document has been updated. However, a changed ID can also be due to internal factors such as ID format changes.|
|» suggestedDocumentStyleChanges|body|object|false|Output only. The suggested changes to the style of the document, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[SuggestedDocumentStyle](#schemasuggesteddocumentstyle)|false|A suggested change to the DocumentStyle.|
|» suggestedNamedStylesChanges|body|object|false|Output only. The suggested changes to the named styles of the document, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[SuggestedNamedStyles](#schemasuggestednamedstyles)|false|A suggested change to the NamedStyles.|
|» suggestionsViewMode|body|string|false|Output only. The suggestions view mode applied to the document. Note: When editing a document, changes must be based on a document with SUGGESTIONS_INLINE.|
|» title|body|string|false|The title of the document.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|[Document](#schemadocument)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
Oauth2 ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents ) & Oauth2c ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents ), Oauth2 ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive ) & Oauth2c ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive ), Oauth2 ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file ) & Oauth2c ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file )
</aside>

## docs.documents.get

<a id="opIddocs.documents.get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/v1/documents/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /v1/documents/{documentId}`

Gets the latest version of the specified document.

<h3 id="docsdocumentsget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|documentId|path|string|true|The ID of the document to retrieve.|
|suggestionsViewMode|query|string|false|The suggestions view mode to apply to the document. This allows viewing the document with all suggestions inline, accepted or rejected. If one is not specified, DEFAULT_FOR_CURRENT_ACCESS is used.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|suggestionsViewMode|DEFAULT_FOR_CURRENT_ACCESS|
|suggestionsViewMode|SUGGESTIONS_INLINE|
|suggestionsViewMode|PREVIEW_SUGGESTIONS_ACCEPTED|
|suggestionsViewMode|PREVIEW_WITHOUT_SUGGESTIONS|
|$.xgafv|1|
|$.xgafv|2|
|alt|json|
|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

`POST /v1/documents/{documentId}:batchUpdate`

Applies one or more updates to the document. Each request is validated before being applied. If any request is not valid, then the entire request will fail and nothing will be applied. Some requests have replies to give you some information about how they are applied. Other requests do not need to return information; these each return an empty reply. The order of replies matches that of the requests. For example, suppose you call batchUpdate with four updates, and only the third one returns information. The response would have two empty replies, the reply to the third request, and another empty reply, in that order. Because other users may be editing the document, the document might not exactly reflect your changes: your changes may be altered with respect to collaborator changes. If there are no collaborators, the document should reflect your changes. In any case, the updates in your request are guaranteed to be applied together atomically.

A ParagraphElement representing a spot in the text that's dynamically replaced with content that can change over time, like a page number.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested insertion IDs. An AutoText may have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedTextStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested text style changes to this AutoText, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this AutoText.|
|type|string|false|none|The type of this auto text.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|type|PAGE_NUMBER|
|type|PAGE_COUNT|

A mask that indicates which of the fields on the base Background have been changed in this suggestion. For any field set to true, the Backgound has a new suggested value.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|backgroundColorSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the current background color has been modified in this suggestion.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|writeControl|[WriteControl](#schemawritecontrol)|false|none|The updated write control after applying the request.|

A mask that indicates which of the fields on the base Bullet have been changed in this suggestion. For any field set to true, there's a new suggested value.

|textStyleSuggestionState|[TextStyleSuggestionState](#schematextstylesuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in text style have been changed in this suggestion.|

A ParagraphElement representing a column break. A column break makes the subsequent text start at the top of the next column.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested insertion IDs. A ColumnBreak may have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedTextStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested text style changes to this ColumnBreak, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this ColumnBreak. Similar to text content, like text runs and footnote references, the text style of a column break can affect content layout as well as the styling of text inserted next to it.|

<h2 id="tocS_CreateFooterRequest">CreateFooterRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreatefooterrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_CreateFooterRequest"></a>
<a id="tocScreatefooterrequest"></a>
<a id="tocscreatefooterrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "sectionBreakLocation": {
    "index": 0,
    "segmentId": "string"
  },
  "type": "HEADER_FOOTER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED"
}
```

Creates a Footer. The new footer is applied to the SectionStyle at the location of the SectionBreak if specified, otherwise it is applied to the DocumentStyle. If a footer of the specified type already exists, a 400 bad request error is returned.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sectionBreakLocation|[Location](#schemalocation)|false|none|The location of the SectionBreak immediately preceding the section whose SectionStyle this footer should belong to. If this is unset or refers to the first section break in the document, the footer applies to the document style.|
|type|string|false|none|The type of footer to create.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|HEADER_FOOTER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|type|DEFAULT|

Creates a Footnote segment and inserts a new FootnoteReference to it at the given location. The new Footnote segment will contain a space followed by a newline character.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endOfSegmentLocation|[EndOfSegmentLocation](#schemaendofsegmentlocation)|false|none|Inserts the footnote reference at the end of the document body. Footnote references cannot be inserted inside a header, footer or footnote. Since footnote references can only be inserted in the body, the segment ID field must be empty.|
|location|[Location](#schemalocation)|false|none|Inserts the footnote reference at a specific index in the document. The footnote reference must be inserted inside the bounds of an existing Paragraph. For instance, it cannot be inserted at a table's start index (i.e. between the table and its preceding paragraph). Footnote references cannot be inserted inside an equation, header, footer or footnote. Since footnote references can only be inserted in the body, the segment ID field must be empty.|

<h2 id="tocS_CreateParagraphBulletsRequest">CreateParagraphBulletsRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="tocScreateparagraphbulletsrequest"></a>
<a id="tocscreateparagraphbulletsrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "bulletPreset": "BULLET_GLYPH_PRESET_UNSPECIFIED",
  "range": {
    "endIndex": 0,
    "segmentId": "string",
    "startIndex": 0
  }
}
```

Creates bullets for all of the paragraphs that overlap with the given range. The nesting level of each paragraph will be determined by counting leading tabs in front of each paragraph. To avoid excess space between the bullet and the corresponding paragraph, these leading tabs are removed by this request. This may change the indices of parts of the text. If the paragraph immediately before paragraphs being updated is in a list with a matching preset, the paragraphs being updated are added to that preceding list.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|bulletPreset|string|false|none|The kinds of bullet glyphs to be used.|
|range|[Range](#schemarange)|false|none|The range to apply the bullet preset to.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_GLYPH_PRESET_UNSPECIFIED|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_DISC_CIRCLE_SQUARE|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_DIAMONDX_ARROW3D_SQUARE|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_CHECKBOX|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_ARROW_DIAMOND_DISC|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_STAR_CIRCLE_SQUARE|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_ARROW3D_CIRCLE_SQUARE|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_LEFTTRIANGLE_DIAMOND_DISC|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_DIAMONDX_HOLLOWDIAMOND_SQUARE|
|bulletPreset|BULLET_DIAMOND_CIRCLE_SQUARE|

<h2 id="tocS_CropProperties">CropProperties</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacropproperties"></a>
<a id="schema_CropProperties"></a>
<a id="tocScropproperties"></a>
<a id="tocscropproperties"></a>

```json
{
  "angle": 0,
  "offsetBottom": 0,
  "offsetLeft": 0,
  "offsetRight": 0,
  "offsetTop": 0
}
```

The crop properties of an image. The crop rectangle is represented using fractional offsets from the original content's 4 edges. - If the offset is in the interval (0, 1), the corresponding edge of crop rectangle is positioned inside of the image's original bounding rectangle. - If the offset is negative or greater than 1, the corresponding edge of crop rectangle is positioned outside of the image's original bounding rectangle. - If all offsets and rotation angle are 0, the image is not cropped.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|angle|number(float)|false|none|The clockwise rotation angle of the crop rectangle around its center, in radians. Rotation is applied after the offsets.|
|offsetBottom|number(float)|false|none|The offset specifies how far inwards the bottom edge of the crop rectangle is from the bottom edge of the original content as a fraction of the original content's height.|
|offsetLeft|number(float)|false|none|The offset specifies how far inwards the left edge of the crop rectangle is from the left edge of the original content as a fraction of the original content's width.|
|offsetRight|number(float)|false|none|The offset specifies how far inwards the right edge of the crop rectangle is from the right edge of the original content as a fraction of the original content's width.|
|offsetTop|number(float)|false|none|The offset specifies how far inwards the top edge of the crop rectangle is from the top edge of the original content as a fraction of the original content's height.|

```json
}
```

A mask that indicates which of the fields on the base CropProperties have been changed in this suggestion. For any field set to true, there's a new suggested value.

### Properties

|---|---|---|---|---|

|offsetBottomSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to offset_bottom.|
|offsetLeftSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to offset_left.|
|offsetRightSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to offset_right.|
|offsetTopSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to offset_top.|

<h2 id="tocS_DeleteContentRangeRequest">DeleteContentRangeRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadeletecontentrangerequest"></a>

```json
{
  "range": {
    "endIndex": 0,
    "segmentId": "string",
    "startIndex": 0
  }
}
```

Deletes content from the document.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|range|[Range](#schemarange)|false|none|The range of content to delete. Deleting text that crosses a paragraph boundary may result in changes to paragraph styles, lists, positioned objects and bookmarks as the two paragraphs are merged. Attempting to delete certain ranges can result in an invalid document structure in which case a 400 bad request error is returned. Some examples of invalid delete requests include: * Deleting one code unit of a surrogate pair. * Deleting the last newline character of a Body, Header, Footer, Footnote, TableCell or TableOfContents. * Deleting the start or end of a Table, TableOfContents or Equation without deleting the entire element. * Deleting the newline character before a Table, TableOfContents or SectionBreak without deleting the element. * Deleting individual rows or cells of a table. Deleting the content within a table cell is allowed.|

A Google Docs document.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|[Body](#schemabody)|false|none|Output only. The main body of the document.|
|documentId|string|false|none|Output only. The ID of the document.|
|documentStyle|[DocumentStyle](#schemadocumentstyle)|false|none|Output only. The style of the document.|
|footers|object|false|none|Output only. The footers in the document, keyed by footer ID.|
|footnotes|object|false|none|Output only. The footnotes in the document, keyed by footnote ID.|
|headers|object|false|none|Output only. The headers in the document, keyed by header ID.|
|inlineObjects|object|false|none|Output only. The inline objects in the document, keyed by object ID.|
|lists|object|false|none|Output only. The lists in the document, keyed by list ID.|
|namedRanges|object|false|none|Output only. The named ranges in the document, keyed by name.|
|namedStyles|[NamedStyles](#schemanamedstyles)|false|none|Output only. The named styles of the document.|
|positionedObjects|object|false|none|Output only. The positioned objects in the document, keyed by object ID.|
|revisionId|string|false|none|Output only. The revision ID of the document. Can be used in update requests to specify which revision of a document to apply updates to and how the request should behave if the document has been edited since that revision. Only populated if the user has edit access to the document. The revision ID is not a sequential number but an opaque string. The format of the revision ID might change over time. A returned revision ID is only guaranteed to be valid for 24 hours after it has been returned and cannot be shared across users. If the revision ID is unchanged between calls, then the document has not changed. Conversely, a changed ID (for the same document and user) usually means the document has been updated. However, a changed ID can also be due to internal factors such as ID format changes.|
|suggestedDocumentStyleChanges|object|false|none|Output only. The suggested changes to the style of the document, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|suggestedNamedStylesChanges|object|false|none|Output only. The suggested changes to the named styles of the document, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|suggestionsViewMode|string|false|none|Output only. The suggestions view mode applied to the document. Note: When editing a document, changes must be based on a document with SUGGESTIONS_INLINE.|
|title|string|false|none|The title of the document.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|suggestionsViewMode|DEFAULT_FOR_CURRENT_ACCESS|
|suggestionsViewMode|SUGGESTIONS_INLINE|
|suggestionsViewMode|PREVIEW_SUGGESTIONS_ACCEPTED|
|suggestionsViewMode|PREVIEW_WITHOUT_SUGGESTIONS|

The style of the document.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|background|[Background](#schemabackground)|false|none|The background of the document. Documents cannot have a transparent background color.|
|defaultFooterId|string|false|none|The ID of the default footer. If not set, there's no default footer. This property is read-only.|
|defaultHeaderId|string|false|none|The ID of the default header. If not set, there's no default header. This property is read-only.|
|evenPageFooterId|string|false|none|The ID of the footer used only for even pages. The value of use_even_page_header_footer determines whether to use the default_footer_id or this value for the footer on even pages. If not set, there's no even page footer. This property is read-only.|
|evenPageHeaderId|string|false|none|The ID of the header used only for even pages. The value of use_even_page_header_footer determines whether to use the default_header_id or this value for the header on even pages. If not set, there's no even page header. This property is read-only.|
|firstPageFooterId|string|false|none|The ID of the footer used only for the first page. If not set then a unique footer for the first page does not exist. The value of use_first_page_header_footer determines whether to use the default_footer_id or this value for the footer on the first page. If not set, there's no first page footer. This property is read-only.|
|firstPageHeaderId|string|false|none|The ID of the header used only for the first page. If not set then a unique header for the first page does not exist. The value of use_first_page_header_footer determines whether to use the default_header_id or this value for the header on the first page. If not set, there's no first page header. This property is read-only.|
|flipPageOrientation|boolean|false|none|Optional. Indicates whether to flip the dimensions of the page_size, which allows changing the page orientation between portrait and landscape.|
|marginBottom|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The bottom page margin. Updating the bottom page margin on the document style clears the bottom page margin on all section styles.|
|marginFooter|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of space between the bottom of the page and the contents of the footer.|
|marginHeader|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of space between the top of the page and the contents of the header.|
|marginLeft|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The left page margin. Updating the left page margin on the document style clears the left page margin on all section styles. It may also cause columns to resize in all sections.|
|marginRight|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The right page margin. Updating the right page margin on the document style clears the right page margin on all section styles. It may also cause columns to resize in all sections.|
|marginTop|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The top page margin. Updating the top page margin on the document style clears the top page margin on all section styles.|
|pageNumberStart|integer(int32)|false|none|The page number from which to start counting the number of pages.|
|pageSize|[Size](#schemasize)|false|none|The size of a page in the document.|
|useCustomHeaderFooterMargins|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether DocumentStyle margin_header, SectionStyle margin_header and DocumentStyle margin_footer, SectionStyle margin_footer are respected. When false, the default values in the Docs editor for header and footer margin are used. This property is read-only.|
|useEvenPageHeaderFooter|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether to use the even page header / footer IDs for the even pages.|
|useFirstPageHeaderFooter|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether to use the first page header / footer IDs for the first page.|

A border around an EmbeddedObject.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|color|[OptionalColor](#schemaoptionalcolor)|false|none|The color of the border.|
|dashStyle|string|false|none|The dash style of the border.|
|propertyState|string|false|none|The property state of the border property.|
|width|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The width of the border.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|dashStyle|DASH_STYLE_UNSPECIFIED|
|dashStyle|SOLID|
|dashStyle|DOT|
|dashStyle|DASH|
|propertyState|RENDERED|
|propertyState|NOT_RENDERED|

<h2 id="tocS_EmbeddedObjectBorderSuggestionState">EmbeddedObjectBorderSuggestionState</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaembeddedobjectbordersuggestionstate"></a>
<a id="schema_EmbeddedObjectBorderSuggestionState"></a>
<a id="tocSembeddedobjectbordersuggestionstate"></a>
<a id="tocsembeddedobjectbordersuggestionstate"></a>

```json
{
  "colorSuggested": true,
  "dashStyleSuggested": true,
  "propertyStateSuggested": true,
  "widthSuggested": true
}
```

A mask that indicates which of the fields on the base EmbeddedObjectBorder have been changed in this suggestion. For any field set to true, there's a new suggested value.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|colorSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to color.|
|dashStyleSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to dash_style.|
|propertyStateSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to property_state.|
|widthSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to width.|

A mask that indicates which of the fields on the base EmbeddedObject have been changed in this suggestion. For any field set to true, there's a new suggested value.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|descriptionSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to description.|
|embeddedDrawingPropertiesSuggestionState|[EmbeddedDrawingPropertiesSuggestionState](#schemaembeddeddrawingpropertiessuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in embedded_drawing_properties have been changed in this suggestion.|
|embeddedObjectBorderSuggestionState|[EmbeddedObjectBorderSuggestionState](#schemaembeddedobjectbordersuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in embedded_object_border have been changed in this suggestion.|
|imagePropertiesSuggestionState|[ImagePropertiesSuggestionState](#schemaimagepropertiessuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in image_properties have been changed in this suggestion.|
|linkedContentReferenceSuggestionState|[LinkedContentReferenceSuggestionState](#schemalinkedcontentreferencesuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in linked_content_reference have been changed in this suggestion.|
|marginBottomSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to margin_bottom.|
|marginLeftSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to margin_left.|
|marginRightSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to margin_right.|
|marginTopSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to margin_top.|
|sizeSuggestionState|[SizeSuggestionState](#schemasizesuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in size have been changed in this suggestion.|
|titleSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to title.|

<h2 id="tocS_EndOfSegmentLocation">EndOfSegmentLocation</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaendofsegmentlocation"></a>
<a id="schema_EndOfSegmentLocation"></a>
<a id="tocSendofsegmentlocation"></a>
<a id="tocsendofsegmentlocation"></a>

```json
{
  "segmentId": "string"
}
```

Location at the end of a body, header, footer or footnote. The location is immediately before the last newline in the document segment.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|segmentId|string|false|none|The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.|

<h2 id="tocS_Equation">Equation</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaequation"></a>
<a id="schema_Equation"></a>
<a id="tocSequation"></a>
<a id="tocsequation"></a>

```json
{
  "suggestedDeletionIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "suggestedInsertionIds": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

A ParagraphElement representing an equation.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested insertion IDs. An Equation may have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|

A ParagraphElement representing a footnote reference. A footnote reference is the inline content rendered with a number and is used to identify the footnote.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|footnoteId|string|false|none|The ID of the footnote that contains the content of this footnote reference.|
|footnoteNumber|string|false|none|The rendered number of this footnote.|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested insertion IDs. A FootnoteReference may have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedTextStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested text style changes to this FootnoteReference, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this FootnoteReference.|

A ParagraphElement representing a horizontal line.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested insertion IDs. A HorizontalRule may have multiple insertion IDs if it is a nested suggested change. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedTextStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested text style changes to this HorizontalRule, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this HorizontalRule. Similar to text content, like text runs and footnote references, the text style of a horizontal rule can affect content layout as well as the styling of text inserted next to it.|

<h2 id="tocS_ImageProperties">ImageProperties</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaimageproperties"></a>

```json
{
  "angle": 0,
  "brightness": 0,
  "contentUri": "string",
  "contrast": 0,
  "cropProperties": {
    "angle": 0,

  },

  "transparency": 0
}
```

The properties of an image.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|angle|number(float)|false|none|The clockwise rotation angle of the image, in radians.|
|brightness|number(float)|false|none|The brightness effect of the image. The value should be in the interval [-1.0, 1.0], where 0 means no effect.|
|contentUri|string|false|none|A URI to the image with a default lifetime of 30 minutes. This URI is tagged with the account of the requester. Anyone with the URI effectively accesses the image as the original requester. Access to the image may be lost if the document's sharing settings change.|
|contrast|number(float)|false|none|The contrast effect of the image. The value should be in the interval [-1.0, 1.0], where 0 means no effect.|
|cropProperties|[CropProperties](#schemacropproperties)|false|none|The crop properties of the image.|
|sourceUri|string|false|none|The source URI is the URI used to insert the image. The source URI can be empty.|
|transparency|number(float)|false|none|The transparency effect of the image. The value should be in the interval [0.0, 1.0], where 0 means no effect and 1 means transparent.|

A mask that indicates which of the fields on the base ImageProperties have been changed in this suggestion. For any field set to true, there's a new suggested value.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|angleSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to angle.|
|brightnessSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to brightness.|
|contentUriSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to content_uri.|
|contrastSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to contrast.|
|cropPropertiesSuggestionState|[CropPropertiesSuggestionState](#schemacroppropertiessuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in crop_properties have been changed in this suggestion.|
|sourceUriSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to source_uri.|
|transparencySuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to transparency.|

|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this InlineObjectElement. Similar to text content, like text runs and footnote references, the text style of an inline object element can affect content layout as well as the styling of text inserted next to it.|

Inserts an InlineObject containing an image at the given location.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endOfSegmentLocation|[EndOfSegmentLocation](#schemaendofsegmentlocation)|false|none|Inserts the text at the end of a header, footer or the document body. Inline images cannot be inserted inside a footnote.|
|location|[Location](#schemalocation)|false|none|Inserts the image at a specific index in the document. The image must be inserted inside the bounds of an existing Paragraph. For instance, it cannot be inserted at a table's start index (i.e. between the table and its preceding paragraph). Inline images cannot be inserted inside a footnote or equation.|
|objectSize|[Size](#schemasize)|false|none|The size that the image should appear as in the document. This property is optional and the final size of the image in the document is determined by the following rules: * If neither width nor height is specified, then a default size of the image is calculated based on its resolution. * If one dimension is specified then the other dimension is calculated to preserve the aspect ratio of the image. * If both width and height are specified, the image is scaled to fit within the provided dimensions while maintaining its aspect ratio.|
|uri|string|false|none|The image URI. The image is fetched once at insertion time and a copy is stored for display inside the document. Images must be less than 50MB in size, cannot exceed 25 megapixels, and must be in one of PNG, JPEG, or GIF format. The provided URI must be publicly accessible and at most 2 kB in length. The URI itself is saved with the image, and exposed via the ImageProperties.content_uri field.|

Inserts a page break followed by a newline at the specified location.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endOfSegmentLocation|[EndOfSegmentLocation](#schemaendofsegmentlocation)|false|none|Inserts the page break at the end of the document body. Page breaks cannot be inserted inside a footnote, header or footer. Since page breaks can only be inserted inside the body, the segment ID field must be empty.|
|location|[Location](#schemalocation)|false|none|Inserts the page break at a specific index in the document. The page break must be inserted inside the bounds of an existing Paragraph. For instance, it cannot be inserted at a table's start index (i.e. between the table and its preceding paragraph). Page breaks cannot be inserted inside a table, equation, footnote, header or footer. Since page breaks can only be inserted inside the body, the segment ID field must be empty.|

Inserts a section break at the given location. A newline character will be inserted before the section break.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endOfSegmentLocation|[EndOfSegmentLocation](#schemaendofsegmentlocation)|false|none|Inserts a newline and a section break at the end of the document body. Section breaks cannot be inserted inside a footnote, header or footer. Because section breaks can only be inserted inside the body, the segment ID field must be empty.|
|location|[Location](#schemalocation)|false|none|Inserts a newline and a section break at a specific index in the document. The section break must be inserted inside the bounds of an existing Paragraph. For instance, it cannot be inserted at a table's start index (i.e. between the table and its preceding paragraph). Section breaks cannot be inserted inside a table, equation, footnote, header, or footer. Since section breaks can only be inserted inside the body, the segment ID field must be empty.|
|sectionType|string|false|none|The type of section to insert.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|sectionType|SECTION_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|sectionType|CONTINUOUS|
|sectionType|NEXT_PAGE|

Inserts a table at the specified location. A newline character will be inserted before the inserted table.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|columns|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of columns in the table.|
|endOfSegmentLocation|[EndOfSegmentLocation](#schemaendofsegmentlocation)|false|none|Inserts the table at the end of the given header, footer or document body. A newline character will be inserted before the inserted table. Tables cannot be inserted inside a footnote.|
|location|[Location](#schemalocation)|false|none|Inserts the table at a specific model index. A newline character will be inserted before the inserted table, therefore the table start index will be at the specified location index + 1. The table must be inserted inside the bounds of an existing Paragraph. For instance, it cannot be inserted at a table's start index (i.e. between an existing table and its preceding paragraph). Tables cannot be inserted inside a footnote or equation.|
|rows|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of rows in the table.|

Inserts text at the specified location.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endOfSegmentLocation|[EndOfSegmentLocation](#schemaendofsegmentlocation)|false|none|Inserts the text at the end of a header, footer, footnote or the document body.|
|location|[Location](#schemalocation)|false|none|Inserts the text at a specific index in the document. Text must be inserted inside the bounds of an existing Paragraph. For instance, text cannot be inserted at a table's start index (i.e. between the table and its preceding paragraph). The text must be inserted in the preceding paragraph.|
|text|string|false|none|The text to be inserted. Inserting a newline character will implicitly create a new Paragraph at that index. The paragraph style of the new paragraph will be copied from the paragraph at the current insertion index, including lists and bullets. Text styles for inserted text will be determined automatically, generally preserving the styling of neighboring text. In most cases, the text style for the inserted text will match the text immediately before the insertion index. Some control characters (U+0000-U+0008, U+000C-U+001F) and characters from the Unicode Basic Multilingual Plane Private Use Area (U+E000-U+F8FF) will be stripped out of the inserted text.|

The properties of a list that describe the look and feel of bullets belonging to paragraphs associated with a list.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|nestingLevels|[[NestingLevel](#schemanestinglevel)]|false|none|Describes the properties of the bullets at the associated level. A list has at most 9 levels of nesting with nesting level 0 corresponding to the top-most level and nesting level 8 corresponding to the most nested level. The nesting levels are returned in ascending order with the least nested returned first.|

```json
      }
    }
```

Merges cells in a Table.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|tableRange|[TableRange](#schematablerange)|false|none|The table range specifying which cells of the table to merge. Any text in the cells being merged will be concatenated and stored in the "head" cell of the range. This is the upper-left cell of the range when the content direction is left to right, and the upper-right cell of the range otherwise. If the range is non-rectangular (which can occur in some cases where the range covers cells that are already merged or where the table is non-rectangular), a 400 bad request error is returned.|

<h2 id="tocS_NamedRange">NamedRange</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemanamedrange"></a>
<a id="schema_NamedRange"></a>
<a id="tocSnamedrange"></a>
<a id="tocsnamedrange"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "namedRangeId": "string",
  "ranges": [
    {
      "endIndex": 0,
      "segmentId": "string",
      "startIndex": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

A collection of Ranges with the same named range ID. Named ranges allow developers to associate parts of a document with an arbitrary user-defined label so their contents can be programmatically read or edited later. A document can contain multiple named ranges with the same name, but every named range has a unique ID. A named range is created with a single Range, and content inserted inside a named range generally expands that range. However, certain document changes can cause the range to be split into multiple ranges. Named ranges are not private. All applications and collaborators that have access to the document can see its named ranges.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the named range.|
|namedRangeId|string|false|none|The ID of the named range.|
|ranges|[[Range](#schemarange)]|false|none|The ranges that belong to this named range.|

```json
    "weightedFontFamily": {
      "fontFamily": "string",
      "weight": 0
    }
  }
}
```

Contains properties describing the look and feel of a list bullet at a given level of nesting.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|bulletAlignment|string|false|none|The alignment of the bullet within the space allotted for rendering the bullet.|
|glyphFormat|string|false|none|The format string used by bullets at this level of nesting. The glyph format contains one or more placeholders, and these placeholders are replaced with the appropriate values depending on the glyph_type or glyph_symbol. The placeholders follow the pattern `%[nesting_level]`. Furthermore, placeholders can have prefixes and suffixes. Thus, the glyph format follows the pattern `%[nesting_level]`. Note that the prefix and suffix are optional and can be arbitrary strings. For example, the glyph format `%0.` indicates that the rendered glyph will replace the placeholder with the corresponding glyph for nesting level 0 followed by a period as the suffix. So a list with a glyph type of UPPER_ALPHA and glyph format `%0.` at nesting level 0 will result in a list with rendered glyphs `A.` `B.` `C.` The glyph format can contain placeholders for the current nesting level as well as placeholders for parent nesting levels. For example, a list can have a glyph format of `%0.` at nesting level 0 and a glyph format of `%0.%1.` at nesting level 1. Assuming both nesting levels have DECIMAL glyph types, this would result in a list with rendered glyphs `1.` `2.` ` 2.1.` ` 2.2.` `3.` For nesting levels that are ordered, the string that replaces a placeholder in the glyph format for a particular paragraph depends on the paragraph's order within the list.|
|glyphSymbol|string|false|none|A custom glyph symbol used by bullets when paragraphs at this level of nesting are unordered. The glyph symbol replaces placeholders within the glyph_format. For example, if the glyph_symbol is the solid circle corresponding to Unicode U+25cf code point and the glyph_format is `%0`, the rendered glyph would be the solid circle.|
|glyphType|string|false|none|The type of glyph used by bullets when paragraphs at this level of nesting are ordered. The glyph type determines the type of glyph used to replace placeholders within the glyph_format when paragraphs at this level of nesting are ordered. For example, if the nesting level is 0, the glyph_format is `%0.` and the glyph type is DECIMAL, then the rendered glyph would replace the placeholder `%0` in the glyph format with a number corresponding to list item's order within the list.|
|indentFirstLine|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of indentation for the first line of paragraphs at this level of nesting.|
|indentStart|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of indentation for paragraphs at this level of nesting. Applied to the side that corresponds to the start of the text, based on the paragraph's content direction.|
|startNumber|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of the first list item at this nesting level. A value of 0 is treated as a value of 1 for lettered lists and Roman numeral lists. For values of both 0 and 1, lettered and Roman numeral lists will begin at `a` and `i` respectively. This value is ignored for nesting levels with unordered glyphs.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of bullets at this level of nesting.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|bulletAlignment|BULLET_ALIGNMENT_UNSPECIFIED|
|bulletAlignment|START|
|bulletAlignment|CENTER|
|bulletAlignment|END|
|glyphType|GLYPH_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|glyphType|NONE|
|glyphType|DECIMAL|
|glyphType|ZERO_DECIMAL|
|glyphType|UPPER_ALPHA|
|glyphType|ALPHA|
|glyphType|UPPER_ROMAN|
|glyphType|ROMAN|

A mask that indicates which of the fields on the base NestingLevel have been changed in this suggestion. For any field set to true, there's a new suggested value.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|bulletAlignmentSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to bullet_alignment.|
|glyphFormatSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to glyph_format.|
|glyphSymbolSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to glyph_symbol.|
|glyphTypeSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to glyph_type.|
|indentFirstLineSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to indent_first_line.|
|indentStartSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to indent_start.|
|startNumberSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to start_number.|
|textStyleSuggestionState|[TextStyleSuggestionState](#schematextstylesuggestionstate)|false|none|A mask that indicates which of the fields in text style have been changed in this suggestion.|

A ParagraphElement representing a page break. A page break makes the subsequent text start at the top of the next page.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested insertion IDs. A PageBreak may have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedTextStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested text style changes to this PageBreak, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this PageBreak. Similar to text content, like text runs and footnote references, the text style of a page break can affect content layout as well as the styling of text inserted next to it.|


A StructuralElement representing a paragraph. A paragraph is a range of content that's terminated with a newline character.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|bullet|[Bullet](#schemabullet)|false|none|The bullet for this paragraph. If not present, the paragraph does not belong to a list.|
|elements|[[ParagraphElement](#schemaparagraphelement)]|false|none|The content of the paragraph, broken down into its component parts.|
|paragraphStyle|[ParagraphStyle](#schemaparagraphstyle)|false|none|The style of this paragraph.|
|positionedObjectIds|[string]|false|none|The IDs of the positioned objects tethered to this paragraph.|
|suggestedBulletChanges|object|false|none|The suggested changes to this paragraph's bullet.|
|suggestedParagraphStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested paragraph style changes to this paragraph, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|suggestedPositionedObjectIds|object|false|none|The IDs of the positioned objects suggested to be attached to this paragraph, keyed by suggestion ID.|

A border around a paragraph.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|color|[OptionalColor](#schemaoptionalcolor)|false|none|The color of the border.|
|dashStyle|string|false|none|The dash style of the border.|
|padding|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The padding of the border.|
|width|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The width of the border.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|dashStyle|DASH_STYLE_UNSPECIFIED|
|dashStyle|SOLID|
|dashStyle|DOT|
|dashStyle|DASH|

Styles that apply to a whole paragraph. Inherited paragraph styles are represented as unset fields in this message. A paragraph style's parent depends on where the paragraph style is defined: * The ParagraphStyle on a Paragraph inherits from the paragraph's corresponding named style type. * The ParagraphStyle on a named style inherits from the normal text named style. * The ParagraphStyle of the normal text named style inherits from the default paragraph style in the Docs editor. * The ParagraphStyle on a Paragraph element that's contained in a table may inherit its paragraph style from the table style. If the paragraph style does not inherit from a parent, unsetting fields will revert the style to a value matching the defaults in the Docs editor.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alignment|string|false|none|The text alignment for this paragraph.|
|avoidWidowAndOrphan|boolean|false|none|Whether to avoid widows and orphans for the paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|borderBetween|[ParagraphBorder](#schemaparagraphborder)|false|none|The border between this paragraph and the next and previous paragraphs. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent. The between border is rendered when the adjacent paragraph has the same border and indent properties. Paragraph borders cannot be partially updated. When changing a paragraph border, the new border must be specified in its entirety.|
|borderBottom|[ParagraphBorder](#schemaparagraphborder)|false|none|The border at the bottom of this paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent. The bottom border is rendered when the paragraph below has different border and indent properties. Paragraph borders cannot be partially updated. When changing a paragraph border, the new border must be specified in its entirety.|
|borderLeft|[ParagraphBorder](#schemaparagraphborder)|false|none|The border to the left of this paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent. Paragraph borders cannot be partially updated. When changing a paragraph border, the new border must be specified in its entirety.|
|borderRight|[ParagraphBorder](#schemaparagraphborder)|false|none|The border to the right of this paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent. Paragraph borders cannot be partially updated. When changing a paragraph border, the new border must be specified in its entirety.|
|borderTop|[ParagraphBorder](#schemaparagraphborder)|false|none|The border at the top of this paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent. The top border is rendered when the paragraph above has different border and indent properties. Paragraph borders cannot be partially updated. When changing a paragraph border, the new border must be specified in its entirety.|
|direction|string|false|none|The text direction of this paragraph. If unset, the value defaults to LEFT_TO_RIGHT since paragraph direction is not inherited.|
|headingId|string|false|none|The heading ID of the paragraph. If empty, then this paragraph is not a heading. This property is read-only.|
|indentEnd|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of indentation for the paragraph on the side that corresponds to the end of the text, based on the current paragraph direction. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|indentFirstLine|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of indentation for the first line of the paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|indentStart|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of indentation for the paragraph on the side that corresponds to the start of the text, based on the current paragraph direction. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|keepLinesTogether|boolean|false|none|Whether all lines of the paragraph should be laid out on the same page or column if possible. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|keepWithNext|boolean|false|none|Whether at least a part of this paragraph should be laid out on the same page or column as the next paragraph if possible. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|lineSpacing|number(float)|false|none|The amount of space between lines, as a percentage of normal, where normal is represented as 100.0. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|namedStyleType|string|false|none|The named style type of the paragraph. Since updating the named style type affects other properties within ParagraphStyle, the named style type is applied before the other properties are updated.|
|pageBreakBefore|boolean|false|none|Whether the current paragraph should always start at the beginning of a page. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent. Attempting to update page_break_before for paragraphs in unsupported regions, including Table, Header, Footer and Footnote, can result in an invalid document state that returns a 400 bad request error.|
|shading|[Shading](#schemashading)|false|none|The shading of the paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|spaceAbove|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of extra space above the paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|spaceBelow|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The amount of extra space below the paragraph. If unset, the value is inherited from the parent.|
|spacingMode|string|false|none|The spacing mode for the paragraph.|
|tabStops|[[TabStop](#schematabstop)]|false|none|A list of the tab stops for this paragraph. The list of tab stops is not inherited. This property is read-only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|indentFirstLineSuggested|boolean|false|none|Indicates if there was a suggested change to indent_first_line.|

A person or email address mentioned in a document. These mentions behave as a single, immutable element containing the person's name or email address.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|personId|string|false|read-only|Output only. The unique ID of this link.|
|personProperties|[PersonProperties](#schemapersonproperties)|false|none|Output only. The properties of this Person. This field is always present.|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|IDs for suggestions that remove this person link from the document. A Person might have multiple deletion IDs if, for example, multiple users suggest deleting it. If empty, then this person link isn't suggested for deletion.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|IDs for suggestions that insert this person link into the document. A Person might have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change (a suggestion within a suggestion made by a different user, for example). If empty, then this person link isn't a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedTextStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested text style changes to this Person, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this Person.|

An object that's tethered to a Paragraph and positioned relative to the beginning of the paragraph. A PositionedObject contains an EmbeddedObject such as an image.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|objectId|string|false|none|The ID of this positioned object.|
|positionedObjectProperties|[PositionedObjectProperties](#schemapositionedobjectproperties)|false|none|The properties of this positioned object.|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionId|string|false|none|The suggested insertion ID. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedPositionedObjectPropertiesChanges|object|false|none|The suggested changes to the positioned object properties, keyed by suggestion ID.|

<h2 id="tocS_PositionedObjectPositioning">PositionedObjectPositioning</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

```json
  "leftOffset": {
    "magnitude": 0,
    "unit": "UNIT_UNSPECIFIED"
  },

    "magnitude": 0,
    "unit": "UNIT_UNSPECIFIED"
  }
}
```

The positioning of a PositionedObject. The positioned object is positioned relative to the beginning of the Paragraph it's tethered to.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|layout|string|false|none|The layout of this positioned object.|
|leftOffset|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The offset of the left edge of the positioned object relative to the beginning of the Paragraph it's tethered to. The exact positioning of the object can depend on other content in the document and the document's styling.|
|topOffset|[Dimension](#schemadimension)|false|none|The offset of the top edge of the positioned object relative to the beginning of the Paragraph it's tethered to. The exact positioning of the object can depend on other content in the document and the document's styling.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|layout|POSITIONED_OBJECT_LAYOUT_UNSPECIFIED|
|layout|WRAP_TEXT|
|layout|BREAK_LEFT|
|layout|BREAK_RIGHT|
|layout|BREAK_LEFT_RIGHT|
|layout|IN_FRONT_OF_TEXT|
|layout|BEHIND_TEXT|

```json
{
  "endIndex": 0,
  "segmentId": "string",
  "startIndex": 0
}
```

Specifies a contiguous range of text.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endIndex|integer(int32)|false|none|The zero-based end index of this range, exclusive, in UTF-16 code units. In all current uses, an end index must be provided. This field is an Int32Value in order to accommodate future use cases with open-ended ranges.|
|segmentId|string|false|none|The ID of the header, footer, or footnote that this range is contained in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.|
|startIndex|integer(int32)|false|none|The zero-based start index of this range, in UTF-16 code units. In all current uses, a start index must be provided. This field is an Int32Value in order to accommodate future use cases with open-ended ranges.|

<h2 id="tocS_ReplaceImageRequest">ReplaceImageRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemareplaceimagerequest"></a>
<a id="schema_ReplaceImageRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSreplaceimagerequest"></a>
<a id="tocsreplaceimagerequest"></a>

```json
{
  "imageObjectId": "string",
  "imageReplaceMethod": "IMAGE_REPLACE_METHOD_UNSPECIFIED",
  "uri": "string"
}
```

Replaces an existing image with a new image. Replacing an image removes some image effects from the existing image in order to mirror the behavior of the Docs editor.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|imageObjectId|string|false|none|The ID of the existing image that will be replaced. The ID can be retrieved from the response of a get request.|
|imageReplaceMethod|string|false|none|The replacement method.|
|uri|string|false|none|The URI of the new image. The image is fetched once at insertion time and a copy is stored for display inside the document. Images must be less than 50MB, cannot exceed 25 megapixels, and must be in PNG, JPEG, or GIF format. The provided URI can't surpass 2 KB in length. The URI is saved with the image, and exposed through the ImageProperties.source_uri field.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|imageReplaceMethod|IMAGE_REPLACE_METHOD_UNSPECIFIED|
|imageReplaceMethod|CENTER_CROP|

<h2 id="tocS_ReplaceNamedRangeContentRequest">ReplaceNamedRangeContentRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemareplacenamedrangecontentrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_ReplaceNamedRangeContentRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSreplacenamedrangecontentrequest"></a>
<a id="tocsreplacenamedrangecontentrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "namedRangeId": "string",
  "namedRangeName": "string",
  "text": "string"
}
```

Replaces the contents of the specified NamedRange or NamedRanges with the given replacement content. Note that an individual NamedRange may consist of multiple discontinuous ranges. In this case, only the content in the first range will be replaced. The other ranges and their content will be deleted. In cases where replacing or deleting any ranges would result in an invalid document structure, a 400 bad request error is returned.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namedRangeId|string|false|none|The ID of the named range whose content will be replaced. If there is no named range with the given ID a 400 bad request error is returned.|
|namedRangeName|string|false|none|The name of the NamedRanges whose content will be replaced. If there are multiple named ranges with the given name, then the content of each one will be replaced. If there are no named ranges with the given name, then the request will be a no-op.|
|text|string|false|none|Replaces the content of the specified named range(s) with the given text.|

A single update to apply to a document.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createFooter|[CreateFooterRequest](#schemacreatefooterrequest)|false|none|Creates a footer.|
|createFootnote|[CreateFootnoteRequest](#schemacreatefootnoterequest)|false|none|Creates a footnote.|
|createHeader|[CreateHeaderRequest](#schemacreateheaderrequest)|false|none|Creates a header.|
|createNamedRange|[CreateNamedRangeRequest](#schemacreatenamedrangerequest)|false|none|Creates a named range.|
|createParagraphBullets|[CreateParagraphBulletsRequest](#schemacreateparagraphbulletsrequest)|false|none|Creates bullets for paragraphs.|
|deleteContentRange|[DeleteContentRangeRequest](#schemadeletecontentrangerequest)|false|none|Deletes content from the document.|
|deleteFooter|[DeleteFooterRequest](#schemadeletefooterrequest)|false|none|Deletes a footer from the document.|
|deleteHeader|[DeleteHeaderRequest](#schemadeleteheaderrequest)|false|none|Deletes a header from the document.|
|deleteNamedRange|[DeleteNamedRangeRequest](#schemadeletenamedrangerequest)|false|none|Deletes a named range.|
|deleteParagraphBullets|[DeleteParagraphBulletsRequest](#schemadeleteparagraphbulletsrequest)|false|none|Deletes bullets from paragraphs.|
|deletePositionedObject|[DeletePositionedObjectRequest](#schemadeletepositionedobjectrequest)|false|none|Deletes a positioned object from the document.|
|deleteTableColumn|[DeleteTableColumnRequest](#schemadeletetablecolumnrequest)|false|none|Deletes a column from a table.|
|deleteTableRow|[DeleteTableRowRequest](#schemadeletetablerowrequest)|false|none|Deletes a row from a table.|
|insertInlineImage|[InsertInlineImageRequest](#schemainsertinlineimagerequest)|false|none|Inserts an inline image at the specified location.|
|insertPageBreak|[InsertPageBreakRequest](#schemainsertpagebreakrequest)|false|none|Inserts a page break at the specified location.|
|insertSectionBreak|[InsertSectionBreakRequest](#schemainsertsectionbreakrequest)|false|none|Inserts a section break at the specified location.|
|insertTable|[InsertTableRequest](#schemainserttablerequest)|false|none|Inserts a table at the specified location.|
|insertTableColumn|[InsertTableColumnRequest](#schemainserttablecolumnrequest)|false|none|Inserts an empty column into a table.|
|insertTableRow|[InsertTableRowRequest](#schemainserttablerowrequest)|false|none|Inserts an empty row into a table.|
|insertText|[InsertTextRequest](#schemainserttextrequest)|false|none|Inserts text at the specified location.|
|mergeTableCells|[MergeTableCellsRequest](#schemamergetablecellsrequest)|false|none|Merges cells in a table.|
|pinTableHeaderRows|[PinTableHeaderRowsRequest](#schemapintableheaderrowsrequest)|false|none|Updates the number of pinned header rows in a table.|
|replaceAllText|[ReplaceAllTextRequest](#schemareplacealltextrequest)|false|none|Replaces all instances of the specified text.|
|replaceImage|[ReplaceImageRequest](#schemareplaceimagerequest)|false|none|Replaces an image in the document.|
|replaceNamedRangeContent|[ReplaceNamedRangeContentRequest](#schemareplacenamedrangecontentrequest)|false|none|Replaces the content in a named range.|
|unmergeTableCells|[UnmergeTableCellsRequest](#schemaunmergetablecellsrequest)|false|none|Unmerges cells in a table.|
|updateDocumentStyle|[UpdateDocumentStyleRequest](#schemaupdatedocumentstylerequest)|false|none|Updates the style of the document.|
|updateParagraphStyle|[UpdateParagraphStyleRequest](#schemaupdateparagraphstylerequest)|false|none|Updates the paragraph style at the specified range.|
|updateSectionStyle|[UpdateSectionStyleRequest](#schemaupdatesectionstylerequest)|false|none|Updates the section style of the specified range.|
|updateTableCellStyle|[UpdateTableCellStyleRequest](#schemaupdatetablecellstylerequest)|false|none|Updates the style of table cells.|
|updateTableColumnProperties|[UpdateTableColumnPropertiesRequest](#schemaupdatetablecolumnpropertiesrequest)|false|none|Updates the properties of columns in a table.|
|updateTableRowStyle|[UpdateTableRowStyleRequest](#schemaupdatetablerowstylerequest)|false|none|Updates the row style in a table.|
|updateTextStyle|[UpdateTextStyleRequest](#schemaupdatetextstylerequest)|false|none|Updates the text style at the specified range.|

A link to a Google resource (such as a file in Drive, a YouTube video, or a Calendar event).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|richLinkId|string|false|read-only|Output only. The ID of this link.|
|richLinkProperties|[RichLinkProperties](#schemarichlinkproperties)|false|none|Output only. The properties of this RichLink. This field is always present.|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|IDs for suggestions that remove this link from the document. A RichLink might have multiple deletion IDs if, for example, multiple users suggest deleting it. If empty, then this person link isn't suggested for deletion.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|IDs for suggestions that insert this link into the document. A RichLink might have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change (a suggestion within a suggestion made by a different user, for example). If empty, then this person link isn't a suggested insertion.|
|suggestedTextStyleChanges|object|false|none|The suggested text style changes to this RichLink, keyed by suggestion ID.|
|textStyle|[TextStyle](#schematextstyle)|false|none|The text style of this RichLink.|

Properties specific to a RichLink.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|mimeType|string|false|read-only|Output only. The [MIME type](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/mime-types) of the RichLink, if there's one (for example, when it's a file in Drive).|
|title|string|false|read-only|Output only. The title of the RichLink as displayed in the link. This title matches the title of the linked resource at the time of the insertion or last update of the link. This field is always present.|
|uri|string|false|read-only|Output only. The URI to the RichLink. This is always present.|

```json
    "defaultHeaderId": "string",

    "firstPageHeaderId": "string",

    "string"
  ],
  "suggestedInsertionIds": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

A StructuralElement representing a section break. A section is a range of content that has the same SectionStyle. A section break represents the start of a new section, and the section style applies to the section after the section break. The document body always begins with a section break.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sectionStyle|[SectionStyle](#schemasectionstyle)|false|none|The style of the section after this section break.|
|suggestedDeletionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested deletion IDs. If empty, then there are no suggested deletions of this content.|
|suggestedInsertionIds|[string]|false|none|The suggested insertion IDs. A SectionBreak may have multiple insertion IDs if it's a nested suggested change. If empty, then this is not a suggested insertion.|
